title: Obsession Director Floats an Anthology Series Instead of a Straight Sequel
excerpt:
Curry Barker sees possibilities beyond a second movie.
Star Inde Navarrette is open to revisiting Nikki's story.
body_md:
The breakout horror film Obsession could inspire very different kinds of follow-ups, according to ideas shared by its director and star. Curry Barker has discussed the possibility of expanding the premise into an anthology television series, while Inde Navarrette has expressed interest in returning to her character Nikki for a more personal continuation.

Barker's proposed anthology would explore how different wishes produce their own disturbing consequences. Rather than simply repeating the original characters' ordeal, each installment could examine a separate reality shaped by somebody's desire. That structure would allow new filmmakers and casts to approach the concept from different angles while retaining the central horror of wishes that do not unfold as expected.

Navarrette's preferred direction would instead examine the emotional aftermath of the first film, including Nikki's grief and psychological recovery. Both possibilities remain creative ideas, not formally commissioned productions. No studio announcement has confirmed Obsession 2 or an anthology series, and neither a release date nor a production schedule has been set.
